title: Price a conditional mixed supplier and obstruct its rank-two adapter
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The pinned complete BIT and rational invoice moments have normalized product `0.999999907428687727…` at `κ = 0.00388`. A hypothetical common-type product with those exact labels passes a directed 80-pair finite cutoff at `0.999996911127416`. Separately, the exact one-coordinate conversion works with independent saved input, while an arbitrary diagonal one-call retained-input adapter is impossible on the two-coordinate complex interface.

## Task and overlap

Refined #7852 follow-up on main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, toolkit `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`, and native comparator #7830 at `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`. Consumer #7863 `b3e4412fe01f07dc58305616fabf96345f49a781` and replay #7973 `ac3df5d5c8889f464f575e32dfea43714abf08ca`. Distinct interface evidence from #7868 `3f7c3c1f2a9a0963736562037e01fe41aec46b8c` and #7990 `db6ea61ffb10e28d911c36fcad84cf4a2bac5a98`.

## Validation

Cold extraction passed all 12 hashes and `python3 -I -B screen.py`. Two directed arithmetic engines agree on the finite ratio. The support check enumerates all 256 possible diagonal masks. Archive SHA-256 `9817e2dd4de6a26cc8aa12d69ae48b59cc73bf80697e80d85577b4cb6fcba4ea`.

## Open next questions

Establish a legal common physical operation, price spectator and scratch/clear costs and prove an admissible ordinary BIT interface or a different outer recurrence. No completed mixed or new higher-κ construction is claimed.
